milestones.title: Server-side session expiry
acceptance_criteria: A session older than eight hours is rejected on every path that reads it, with tests proving it

tasks.title: Add auth session tests
tasks.objective: Create tests that pin current session behaviour and fail for an expired session
tasks.estimate_rationale: No auth tests exist yet; auth.ts is 100 lines with one Map, so the tests are short but must build sessions by hand

complexity.justification: Plain unit tests against exported pure-ish functions of auth.ts, no new design

scope.justification: One new test file and nothing else changes in the repository

duration.justification: Existing repository.test.ts shows the harness; sessions need hand-built cookies and time control

risk.justification: Tests only; a wrong test cannot affect production behaviour

coupling.justification: Only reads exported auth functions; T2 will make the new case pass

confidence.justification: auth.ts and the test harness were read completely and are both short

acceptance_criteria: A valid signed session is accepted
A session created more than eight hours ago is rejected

verification.purpose: node --test over apps/api/test/*.test.ts (script exists in apps/api/package.json)

tasks.title: Expire sessions after eight hours
tasks.objective: Reject and purge sessions older than the cookie lifetime in validSignedSession
tasks.estimate_rationale: Two-line comparison in one function, sensitive because every authenticated route and the WebSocket upgrade use it

complexity.justification: One comparison against createdAt in a function that already looks the session up

scope.justification: A single function changes; the cookie Max-Age already defines the intended lifetime

duration.justification: Tiny edit plus running the tests T1 added and the type check of one workspace

risk.justification: Authentication code: a wrong comparison locks every user out or keeps accepting expired sessions

coupling.justification: The WebSocket server calls sessionFromRequest from the same module and the web client relies on the 401 to recreate its session

confidence.justification: Every caller of sessionFromRequest was read and the cookie lifetime is a literal in the same file

acceptance_criteria: Sessions older than 28800 seconds are not accepted by requireAuth, requireMutation or the upgrade handler
The expired entry is deleted from the sessions map
Fresh sessions and the MCP bearer token behave as before

tasks.title: Document the session lifetime
tasks.objective: State in the API contract document that sessions expire eight hours after creation
tasks.estimate_rationale: Prose in an existing document that already describes sessions and CSRF

complexity.justification: Documentation of behaviour that T2 has already fixed

scope.justification: One sentence or short section in one existing document

duration.justification: The document is short and the change is one paragraph

risk.justification: A documentation slip is cosmetic and reviewed in the diff

coupling.justification: It only describes the contract T2 implements and is ordered after it

confidence.justification: The document exists and the behaviour it must describe is fixed by T2

acceptance_criteria: docs/api-contract.md states the eight hour server-side session lifetime

verification.expected: the document says sessions expire eight hours after creation
